prior_related_discovery.relationship: Different signal. Prior study used the near futures-vs-index basis sign to predict a 1:1 near/far spread move. This study ignores the index basis and tests direct mean reversion of the adjacent futures term spread itself.

economic_mechanism: Adjacent BTCDVOL monthly futures share the same underlying volatility index but different expiry horizons. During their listed-life overlap, transient relative-value dislocations between near and far contracts may mean-revert as the near contract approaches settlement while both remain exposed to common DVOL shocks.
failure_mode: Persistent volatility term-structure slope, regime shifts or expiry-specific risk premia can make the near-minus-far spread trend rather than mean-revert.

pair_rule.population: Exact adjacent-expiry BTCDVOL futures with listed-life overlap from the passed calendar-spread source gate.
pair_rule.daily_anchor: For each leg, first ordinary public trade at or after 08:00 UTC on each common active UTC day within exact overlap.
pair_rule.common_day: UTC date with eligible near and far anchors.
pair_rule.next_observation: Next common active UTC day within the same adjacent pair.

signal.direction: spread > 0 => expect spread to fall toward zero; spread < 0 => expect spread to rise toward zero; spread == 0 => zero score.

score.interpretation: Positive means the adjacent term spread moved toward zero.
score.primary_estimand: Equal-weight mean of per-pair mean scores.

no_rescue_rule: After canonical outcome opening, do not change pair construction, 08:00 anchors, spread definition, threshold, score, sample/statistical gates, years or source population under this Discovery ID.
post_pass_rule: PASS authorizes only a separately frozen executable spread MVE with legitimate post-signal fills on both legs and fixed costs.
